style_profile.label: Patient value with an adventurous sleeve
style_profile.description: Concentrated, valuation-aware managers who let durable businesses compound, with room for higher-risk situations when the process remains disciplined and the holding period is measured in quarters rather than weeks.
human_evidence_required: Primary-source evidence of a valuation-aware investment process.
Evidence that the manager is willing to hold through ordinary volatility.
A representative 13F without a dominant hidden short, derivative, private, or foreign book.
No material mandate, succession, legal, or governance concern.

rules.approval: Joe must explicitly approve every new addition.
rules.style: Candidates are split into core patient value and adventurous value lanes.
rules.evidence: 13F behavior nominates; primary-source philosophy review qualifies.
rules.source_verification: Original SEC filing URLs must be checked before an approval is committed.
